7899.title: Request-key reads scale with event history
7899.rootCauseOneLine: Request IDs are filtered from JSON after a thread/type history scan, and the native synchronous read blocks the calling event loop.
7899.proposedFix: Design and validate a migrated request-ID expression index; the disposable full-index experiment changed the bound plan to request-ID seeks.
7899.caveats: Same-agent clean repeat confirms query growth and timer delay, not a full-server HTTP stall or the incident database. No PR: the indexed repair requires a schema migration, outside simple-fix policy.
